---
title: "1c. Clean the psychiatric outcome GWAS"
output: html_document
---

<!--
---- Step 1c | Outcome GWAS cleaning -----------------------------------------
Cleans the ten outcome GWAS as downloaded and counts their genome-wide
significant loci (Supplementary Methods SM2; Table 1):
  - columns renamed to the TwoSampleMR *.outcome convention, and missing
    fields derived (beta from an odds ratio or a Z-score, effective sample
    sizes)
  - filters: 0.05 < EAF < 0.95 for every outcome, and INFO > 0.8 for the five
    files that report it
  - panic: positions lifted to GRCh37 with alleles and effects unchanged, SNV
    alleles complemented where the variant maps to the reverse strand, then
    one row per rsID
  - OUD: European frequencies taken from the 1000 Genomes panel, then the
    frequency filter applied to them
  - loci: index variants p < 5e-8 clumped at r2 < 0.1 within 1 Mb on the EUR
    panel, index variants within 1 Mb merged into one locus, the MHC counted
    once, autosomes only

Reads   raw outcome GWAS, the liftover chain, the LD panel (1b)
Writes  one cleaned file per outcome, and outcome_loci_counts.csv
Feeds   2, 7
-->

```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(rtracklayer)

raw_dir  <- "../MR_data/raw_outcome_GWAS"
out_dir  <- "../MR_data/target_GWASes_updated"
chain    <- "../MR_data/liftover_chain_file/hg38ToHg19.over.chain"
ld_panel <- "../MR_data/LD_reference_panel_1000G_EUR_phase3/EUR"
plink2   <- "plink2"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

write_clean <- function(d, name) fwrite(d, file.path(out_dir, name), sep = "\t", compress = "gzip")
```

## Major depressive disorder (PGC 2025, EUR, no 23andMe or UK Biobank)

```{r mdd}
mdd <- fread(file.path(raw_dir, "pgc-mdd2025_no23andMe-noUKBB_eur_v3-49-24-11.tsv.gz"),
             select = c("#CHROM", "ID", "POS", "EA", "NEA", "FCON", "IMPINFO", "BETA", "SE", "PVAL", "NEFF"))
setnames(mdd, "#CHROM", "CHROM")
mdd <- mdd %>%
  dplyr::select(chr.outcome = CHROM, pos.outcome = POS, SNP = ID, other_allele.outcome = NEA,
                effect_allele.outcome = EA, eaf.outcome = FCON, INFO = IMPINFO, samplesize.outcome = NEFF,
                beta.outcome = BETA, se.outcome = SE, pval.outcome = PVAL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(INFO > 0.8, eaf.outcome > 0.05, eaf.outcome < 0.95)
write_clean(mdd, "pgc-mdd2025_no23andMe-noUKBB_eur_v3-49-24-11.tsv.gz")
```

## Schizophrenia (PGC3, European)

```{r scz}
# NEFF in this file is half the effective sample size
scz <- fread(file.path(raw_dir, "PGC3_SCZ_wave3.european.autosome.public.v3.vcf.tsv.gz"),
             select = c("CHROM", "ID", "POS", "A1", "A2", "FCON", "IMPINFO", "BETA", "SE", "PVAL", "NEFF")) %>%
  mutate(samplesize.outcome = NEFF * 2) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr.outcome = CHROM, pos.outcome = POS, SNP = ID, other_allele.outcome = A2,
                effect_allele.outcome = A1, eaf.outcome = FCON, INFO = IMPINFO, samplesize.outcome,
                beta.outcome = BETA, se.outcome = SE, pval.outcome = PVAL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(INFO > 0.8, eaf.outcome > 0.05, eaf.outcome < 0.95)
write_clean(scz, "PGC3_SCZ_wave3_european_autosome_clean_MAF_GRCh37.tsv.gz")
```

## Bipolar disorder (PGC 2024, EUR, no UK Biobank or 23andMe)

```{r bip}
bip <- fread(file.path(raw_dir, "bip2024_eur_noUKB_no23andMe.gz"),
             select = c("CHR", "SNP", "BP", "A1", "A2", "HRC_FRQ_A1", "INFO", "OR", "SE", "P", "Neff_half")) %>%
  mutate(samplesize.outcome = Neff_half * 2, beta.outcome = log(OR)) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr.outcome = CHR, pos.outcome = BP, SNP, other_allele.outcome = A2, effect_allele.outcome = A1,
                eaf.outcome = HRC_FRQ_A1, INFO, samplesize.outcome, beta.outcome, se.outcome = SE, pval.outcome = P) %>%
  dplyr::filter(INFO > 0.8, eaf.outcome > 0.05, eaf.outcome < 0.95)
write_clean(bip, "bip2024_eur_noUKB_no23andMe.tsv.gz")
```

## Post-traumatic stress disorder (PGC-PTSD freeze 3, EUR)

```{r ptsd}
# The file has Z and effective N only (sample-size-weighted meta-analysis), so
# standardised betas and SEs are derived from Z, allele frequency and N.
ptsd <- fread(file.path(raw_dir, "eur_ptsd_pcs_v4_aug3_2021.vcf.gz"),
              select = c("#CHROM", "ID", "POS", "A1", "A2", "FREQ", "Z", "P", "NEFF"))
setnames(ptsd, "#CHROM", "CHROM")
ptsd <- ptsd %>%
  mutate(beta.outcome = Z / sqrt(2 * FREQ * (1 - FREQ) * (NEFF + Z^2)),
         se.outcome   = 1 / sqrt(2 * FREQ * (1 - FREQ) * (NEFF + Z^2))) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr.outcome = CHROM, pos.outcome = POS, SNP = ID, other_allele.outcome = A2,
                effect_allele.outcome = A1, eaf.outcome = FREQ, samplesize.outcome = NEFF,
                beta.outcome, se.outcome, pval.outcome = P) %>%
  dplyr::filter(eaf.outcome > 0.05, eaf.outcome < 0.95)
write_clean(ptsd, "eur_ptsd_pcs_v4_aug3_2021.tsv.gz")
```

## Panic disorder (FinnGen R12, F5_PANIC)

```{r panic}
# FinnGen reports GRCh38 positions and lists every rsID of a variant in one
# comma-separated field.
cases <- 6911; controls <- 444414
panic <- fread(file.path(raw_dir, "summary_stats_release_finngen_R12_F5_PANIC.gz"),
               select = c("#chrom", "rsids", "pos", "alt", "ref", "af_alt_controls", "beta", "sebeta", "pval"))
setnames(panic, "#chrom", "chrom")
panic <- panic %>%
  mutate(samplesize.outcome = 4 / (1 / cases + 1 / controls)) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr.outcome = chrom, pos.outcome = pos, SNP = rsids, other_allele.outcome = ref,
                effect_allele.outcome = alt, eaf.outcome = af_alt_controls, samplesize.outcome,
                beta.outcome = beta, se.outcome = sebeta, pval.outcome = pval) %>%
  dplyr::filter(eaf.outcome > 0.05, eaf.outcome < 0.95)

panic <- as.data.table(panic)[!is.na(SNP) & SNP != ""][!duplicated(SNP)]
# chr38 and the lifted rows below are matched by position, so panic must not be
# reordered between here and the chromosome check
chr38 <- fifelse(panic$chr.outcome == 23, "X", as.character(panic$chr.outcome))
lo <- liftOver(GRanges(paste0("chr", chr38), IRanges(panic$pos.outcome, width = 1), strand = "+"),
               import.chain(chain))
panic[, n_map := lengths(lo)]
hit <- unlist(lo[panic$n_map == 1])
m <- panic[n_map == 1]
m[, `:=`(chr37 = sub("^chr", "", as.character(seqnames(hit))), pos37 = start(hit),
         strand37 = as.character(strand(hit)))]
m[, same_chr := chr37 == chr38[panic$n_map == 1]]
m[, snv := nchar(effect_allele.outcome) == 1 & nchar(other_allele.outcome) == 1]
m[, keep := same_chr & (strand37 == "+" | snv)]
comp <- function(x) chartr("ACGT", "TGCA", x)
m[keep & strand37 == "-", `:=`(effect_allele.outcome = comp(effect_allele.outcome),
                                other_allele.outcome = comp(other_allele.outcome))]
panic37 <- m[keep == TRUE, .(chr.outcome = chr37, pos.outcome = pos37, SNP, other_allele.outcome,
                             effect_allele.outcome, eaf.outcome, samplesize.outcome, beta.outcome,
                             se.outcome, pval.outcome)]
panic37 <- panic37[order(fifelse(chr.outcome == "X", 23L, suppressWarnings(as.integer(chr.outcome))), pos.outcome)]

split <- panic37[, .(SNP = unlist(strsplit(SNP, ",", fixed = TRUE))), by = setdiff(names(panic37), "SNP")]
split[, SNP := trimws(SNP)]
split <- split[SNP != "" & !is.na(SNP)]
setcolorder(split, names(panic37))
split <- split[!duplicated(SNP)]
write_clean(split, "summary_stats_release_finngen_R12_F5_PANIC_GRCh37_rsID_split.tsv.gz")
```

## Opioid use disorder (Deak et al. 2022, EUR MTAG)

```{r oud}
# The MTAG file reports no allele frequencies.
system2(plink2, c("--bfile", shQuote(ld_panel), "--freq", "--out", shQuote(file.path(tempdir(), "eur"))))
frq <- fread(file.path(tempdir(), "eur.afreq"), select = c("ID", "REF", "ALT", "ALT_FREQS"))
setnames(frq, c("snp", "REF", "ALT", "ALT_FREQS"))
frq <- frq[!duplicated(snp)]
mtag <- fread(cmd = paste("unzip -p", shQuote(file.path(raw_dir, "Deak_2022_OUD_sumstats.zip")),
                          "Deak_2022_OUD_sumstats/OUDMTAG_Sumstats_Deak2022_MTAGcolumns.gz | gzip -dc"),
              select = c("snp", "chr", "bp", "a1", "a2", "mtag_beta", "mtag_se", "mtag_pval"))
d <- merge(mtag, frq, by = "snp", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
d[, eaf_eur := fifelse(is.na(REF), NA_real_,
                       fifelse(a1 == ALT & a2 == REF, ALT_FREQS, fifelse(a1 == REF & a2 == ALT, 1 - ALT_FREQS, NA_real_)))]
oud <- d[!is.na(eaf_eur) & eaf_eur > 0.05 & eaf_eur < 0.95,
         .(chr.outcome = chr, pos.outcome = bp, SNP = snp, other_allele.outcome = a2, effect_allele.outcome = a1,
           eaf.outcome = eaf_eur, samplesize.outcome = 128748, beta.outcome = mtag_beta,
           se.outcome = mtag_se, pval.outcome = mtag_pval)]
write_clean(oud, "OUDMTAG_Sumstats_Deak2022_MTAGcolumns_EURfreq_clean.tsv.gz")
```

```{r trd}
trd <- fread(file.path(raw_dir, "202205_updated_MVP_MGB_VU_normmgh.meta.0.8n.sumstat"),
             select = c("CHR", "SNP", "BP", "A1", "A2", "SE", "BETA", "P", "FREQ", "NMISS")) %>%
```

## Treatment resistance in schizophrenia (Pardiñas et al. 2022)

```{r trs}
# Only MAF is given; A1 is the minor allele (as in PLINK output), so MAF is the
# A1 frequency. The released SNPs are already restricted to MAF >= 0.05.
# N counts individuals, so it is scaled to an effective size using the two comparisons behind the
# interaction: treatment-resistant cases against their controls, and non-resistant against theirs.
neff <- function(cases, controls) 4 / (1 / cases + 1 / controls)
eff_share <- (neff(10501, 24542) + neff(20325, 30122)) / (10501 + 24542 + 20325 + 30122)
trs <- fread(file.path(raw_dir, "trs_interaction.sumstats.txt.gz"),
             select = c("CHR", "SNP", "BP", "A1", "A2", "MAF", "OR", "SE", "P", "N")) %>%
  mutate(beta.outcome = log(OR), samplesize.outcome = N * eff_share) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr.outcome = CHR, pos.outcome = BP, SNP, other_allele.outcome = A2, effect_allele.outcome = A1,
                eaf.outcome = MAF, samplesize.outcome, beta.outcome, se.outcome = SE, pval.outcome = P)
write_clean(trs, "trs_interaction_effectiveN.tsv.gz")
```

## Antidepressant response (Pain et al. 2022, percentage improvement, EUR)

```{r antidepressant}
# Quantitative trait in daner format: Nco counts individuals, not controls, and holds the declared
# size of each contributing cohort rather than the number it phenotyped. Direction names the cohorts
# behind a variant, so each variant's sample size is rescaled to the number they phenotyped.
cohort_declared   <- c(1152, 586, 783, 474, 71, 132, 177, 309, 490, 1202)  # in Direction order, sums to 5,376
cohort_phenotyped <- c(1152, 586, 783, 474, 71, 132, 156, 309, 392, 1163)  # Pain et al. Table 1, sums to 5,218
ad <- fread(file.path(raw_dir, "AntiDepPercImprovEUR2021.gz"),
            select = c("CHR", "SNP", "BP", "A1", "A2", "FRQ_U_5376", "INFO", "OR", "SE", "P", "Nco", "Direction"))
dir_pad <- sprintf("%-10s", ad$Direction)          # a few released strings stop short of ten cohorts
n_declared <- n_phenotyped <- numeric(nrow(ad))
for (i in seq_along(cohort_declared)) {
  contributed  <- !substr(dir_pad, i, i) %in% c("?", " ")
  n_declared   <- n_declared   + contributed * cohort_declared[i]
  n_phenotyped <- n_phenotyped + contributed * cohort_phenotyped[i]
}
stopifnot(mean(n_declared == ad$Nco) > 0.9999, all(n_phenotyped <= n_declared))
ad <- ad %>%
  mutate(samplesize.outcome = Nco * n_phenotyped / n_declared, beta.outcome = log(OR)) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr.outcome = CHR, pos.outcome = BP, SNP, other_allele.outcome = A2, effect_allele.outcome = A1,
                eaf.outcome = FRQ_U_5376, INFO, samplesize.outcome, beta.outcome, se.outcome = SE, pval.outcome = P) %>%
  dplyr::filter(INFO > 0.8, eaf.outcome > 0.05, eaf.outcome < 0.95)
write_clean(ad, "AntiDepPercImprovEUR2021_phenotypeN.tsv.gz")
```

## Genome-wide significant loci per cleaned file (Table 1)

```{r loci}
plink19 <- genetics.binaRies::get_plink_binary()
panel_ids <- fread(paste0(ld_panel, ".bim"), select = 2, header = FALSE)[[1]]
count_loci <- function(file) {
  g <- fread(file.path(out_dir, file), select = c("SNP", "chr.outcome", "pos.outcome", "pval.outcome"))
  g <- g[as.character(chr.outcome) %in% as.character(1:22) & !is.na(pval.outcome)]
  sig <- g[pval.outcome < 5e-8]
  if (!nrow(sig)) return(0L)
  tmp <- tempfile("clump_")
  fwrite(g[pval.outcome < 1e-4, .(SNP, P = pval.outcome)], paste0(tmp, ".assoc"), sep = "\t")
  system2(plink19, c("--bfile", shQuote(ld_panel), "--clump", shQuote(paste0(tmp, ".assoc")),
                     "--clump-p1", "5e-8", "--clump-p2", "1e-4", "--clump-r2", "0.1", "--clump-kb", "1000",
                     "--out", shQuote(tmp)), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)
  cl  <- if (file.exists(paste0(tmp, ".clumped"))) fread(paste0(tmp, ".clumped")) else data.table(SNP = character())
  idx <- g[SNP %in% cl$SNP, .(chr = as.integer(chr.outcome), pos = pos.outcome)]
  idx <- rbind(idx, sig[!SNP %in% panel_ids, .(chr = as.integer(chr.outcome), pos = pos.outcome)])[order(chr, pos)]
  idx[chr == 6 & pos >= 25e6 & pos <= 34e6, pos := 25e6]
  idx <- unique(idx)
  uniqueN(cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(idx$pos) > 1e6 | diff(idx$chr) != 0)))
}
cleaned <- c(
  "Major depressive disorder"             = "pgc-mdd2025_no23andMe-noUKBB_eur_v3-49-24-11.tsv.gz",
  "Schizophrenia"                         = "PGC3_SCZ_wave3_european_autosome_clean_MAF_GRCh37.tsv.gz",
  "Bipolar disorder"                      = "bip2024_eur_noUKB_no23andMe.tsv.gz",
  "Post-traumatic stress disorder"        = "eur_ptsd_pcs_v4_aug3_2021.tsv.gz",
  "Obsessive compulsive disorder"         = "daner_OCDmeta_wo23andMe_LOOUKBB_080425.tsv.gz",
  "Panic disorder"                        = "summary_stats_release_finngen_R12_F5_PANIC_GRCh37_rsID_split.tsv.gz",
  "Opioid use disorder"                   = "OUDMTAG_Sumstats_Deak2022_MTAGcolumns_EURfreq_clean.tsv.gz",
  "Treatment resistance in depression"    = "202205_updated_MVP_MGB_VU_normmgh.meta.0.8n.sumstat.tsv.gz",
  "Treatment resistance in schizophrenia" = "trs_interaction_effectiveN.tsv.gz",
  "Antidepressant response"               = "AntiDepPercImprovEUR2021_phenotypeN.tsv.gz")
loci <- data.table(outcome = names(cleaned), file = cleaned, loci = vapply(cleaned, count_loci, integer(1)))
fwrite(loci, file.path(out_dir, "outcome_loci_counts.csv"))
loci
```
